title: Wire Allocator Into Trading-Engine Main Loop

implementation_summary.martingale_runtime_struct: Added allocator_state: Option<AllocatorState> and strategy_to_sleeve_id: HashMap<String,String> fields to MartingaleRuntime.
implementation_summary.main_rs_helper: runtime_with_allocator_state() parses optional allocator_config + strategy_to_sleeve_id + allocator_state from portfolio JSON, installs state on runtime, returns snapshot.
implementation_summary.main_rs_gate: In the per-strategy loop, before start_cycle_with_futures_preflight: if allocator_allows_new_cycle returns false, record 'martingale_allocator_blocked_new_cycle' event and skip the new cycle. Existing cycles are never touched.
missing_for_full_live_ready: parse allocator_config into production rebalance config
compute per-sleeve rolling metrics from completed production observations
persist updated allocator_state back to portfolio/risk-summary storage

tests: r10_allocator_rebalance_uses_completed_equity_only_in_main_loop (PASS, verifies caller contract with synthetic metrics)

test_counts.backtest_engine: GLM reported 211 passed (188 lib + 23 search_scoring_time_splits), 0 failed
test_counts.trading_engine: GLM reported 198 passed across all binaries (incl. 3 new R10 P1 integration tests), 0 failed

parity_invariants_maintained: Static gate: allocator_allows_new_cycle respects active sleeve when allocator_state is installed
No-force-close: existing cycles remain after sleeve switch in runtime test
Opt-in per sleeve: strategies without a sleeve mapping are not gated
corrected_verdict: R10 P1 is useful but not sufficient for full live-readiness. The trading-engine can statically block new cycles for inactive sleeves when allocator_state is already provided, but the production loop still does not compute rolling allocator metrics, rebalance dynamically, or persist allocator_state. R9 allocator remains research/module-ready plus partial static live gate, not fully live-ready.
